import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/workspace/-MGAR-v2-')
out = root / 'evidence/batches/P0-P3-AUDIT'
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'scripts'))
from source_fingerprint import fingerprint

run = Path((root / '.local/offline-current').read_text().strip())
assert run.resolve().is_relative_to((root / '.local').resolve())
report = json.loads((run / 'report.json').read_text())
assert report['status'] == 'PASS'
assert (run / 'fingerprint').read_text().strip() == fingerprint()
historical = json.loads((out / 'historical-artifact-verification.json').read_text())
count = 0
for row in historical:
    path = f"evidence/batches/{row['card']}/accept.json"
    commit = row['delivery_commit']
    data = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{commit}:{path}'], cwd=root)
    assert (root / path).read_bytes() == data, path
    artifacts = json.loads(data)['artifacts']
    assert len(artifacts) == row['verified_count'] and not row['mismatches']
    for item in artifacts:
        body = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f"{commit}:{item['path']}"], cwd=root)
        assert hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest() == item['sha256'], item['path']
        count += 1
assert len(historical) == 17 and count == 678
for source in sorted(run.iterdir()):
    target = out / ('final-' + source.name + '.json')
    target.write_text(json.dumps({'raw_text': source.read_text()}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
for name in ('mgar-record.py', 'mgar-final-audit.py', 'mgar-export-audit.py'):
    (out / (name + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'raw_text': (Path('/tmp') / name).read_text()}, indent=2) + '\n')
queue = root / 'TASK_QUEUE.md'
body = queue.read_text()
assert body.count('本轮状态 ACTIVE；范围 P0-01～P3-04') == 1
queue.write_text(body.replace('本轮状态 ACTIVE；范围 P0-01～P3-04', '本轮状态 PASS；范围 P0-01～P3-04'))
assert (run / 'fingerprint').read_text().strip() == fingerprint()
print(json.dumps({'status': 'PASS', 'source_fingerprint': fingerprint(), 'historical_cards': 17,
    'historical_artifacts_verified': count, 'final_run_files_exported': len(list(run.iterdir())),
    'test_summary': report}, ensure_ascii=False))
